body.summary: An animated Chinese series in which people called Heroes gain powers from the public's belief in them, and their standing is tracked by a ranking system. The premise turns on the idea that faith and reputation literally fuel superhuman ability, so Heroes compete for attention and can be unmade by losing it. The story follows a young man, X, who enters this world and has to work out what kind of Hero he wants to be while the machinery of ranking and sponsorship shapes everyone around him. ||The series builds toward a confrontation over who controls the belief that powers the Heroes.||
